tests.title: Stripe response is received, process crashes before recording its result

tests.expected_outcome: Recover and reconcile the identifiable original external operation

tests.title: Payments captures a successful charge, process stops before Ordering records paid
tests.theme: Inbox/Outbox, durable Stripe operations and saga
tests.expected_outcome: Ordering eventually applies the payment exactly once

tests.title: The same webhook arrives again or out of order
tests.theme: Inbox/Outbox, durable Stripe operations and saga
tests.expected_outcome: No illegitimate financial regression or duplicated business effect

tests.title: Two workers claim the same durable operation
tests.theme: Inbox/Outbox, durable Stripe operations and saga
tests.expected_outcome: One semantic commercial effect

tests.title: MongoDB is unavailable during an externally valid charge
tests.theme: Inbox/Outbox, durable Stripe operations and saga
tests.expected_outcome: Preserve and recover the commercial obligation after database recovery

tests.title: An internal financial-result message is lost
tests.theme: Inbox/Outbox, durable Stripe operations and saga
tests.expected_outcome: Detect and execute the pending durable handoff

tests.title: CreateRefund returns an HTTP timeout
tests.theme: Inbox/Outbox, durable Stripe operations and saga
tests.expected_outcome: Never issue an uncorrelated duplicate refund; reconcile first

tests.title: Stripe event belongs to another account or tenant
tests.theme: Inbox/Outbox, durable Stripe operations and saga
tests.expected_outcome: Reject attribution and prevent cross-scope mutation

tests.title: MongoDB reports an ambiguous local write result
tests.theme: Inbox/Outbox, durable Stripe operations and saga
tests.expected_outcome: Re-read/reconcile; timeout is not proof the write failed

tests.title: A process restarts after automatic retries are exhausted
tests.theme: Inbox/Outbox, durable Stripe operations and saga
tests.expected_outcome: Durable case persists and is escalated, not silently erased

tests.title: Buyer double-clicks Pay concurrently
tests.expected_outcome: Only one commercial Session authorized and one logical result

tests.title: Card fails within an existing open Stripe Session
tests.expected_outcome: Do not automatically create another commercial PaymentAttempt

tests.title: Session expires and prior negative financial closure is proven
tests.expected_outcome: Allow a successor only if protected Reservation and guards remain valid

tests.title: Stripe Session A was created but its response was lost
tests.expected_outcome: Investigate A; never create successor B merely due to the timeout

tests.title: Session A is complete but its PaymentIntent is processing
tests.expected_outcome: Do not authorize Session B while prior money can settle

tests.title: Late provider webhook contradicts an earlier local closure
tests.expected_outcome: Preserve exposure, investigate, avoid duplicate fulfillment

tests.title: Two workers try to create successor Session B
tests.expected_outcome: Authorize one generation only

tests.title: Worker crashes after authorizing B and before calling Stripe
tests.expected_outcome: Recover the same original external operation identity

tests.title: Original Reservation was already released before requesting B
tests.expected_outcome: Reject reuse of released capacity

tests.title: The accepted number-of-attempts limit was reached
tests.expected_outcome: Do not create another commercial Session absent new approved policy

tests.title: Offer price changes between Session A and B
tests.expected_outcome: Accepted immutable Order snapshot remains unchanged

tests.title: A buyer from another Store attempts to reuse an Attempt
tests.expected_outcome: Reject with no cross-store financial effects

tests.title: First payment confirms while a second opportunity is requested
tests.expected_outcome: Deny incompatible new Session and preserve the confirmed obligation

tests.title: Prior attempt has an unresolved refund
tests.expected_outcome: Do not re-collect the same obligation automatically

tests.title: Authorized express cancellation while Stripe Session is open
tests.expected_outcome: Verify provider expiration and release only after safe financial reconciliation

tests.title: Buyer submits duplicate cancellation requests
tests.expected_outcome: Only one effective commercial cancellation resolution

tests.title: Cancellation competes with 3D Secure confirmation
tests.expected_outcome: Do not release while there is confirmed or unknown money

tests.title: Stripe expiration request response is lost
tests.expected_outcome: Reconcile its actual outcome before Inventory release

tests.title: Stripe reports the Session already expired
tests.expected_outcome: Reconcile all financial opportunities; this is not automatic safe release

tests.title: Stripe reports Session not eligible for expiration
tests.expected_outcome: Inspect completed/processing outcomes and preserve obligation

tests.title: Cancellation occurs while Session creation result is unknown
tests.expected_outcome: Do not orphan a collectible Stripe Session

tests.title: Cancellation races with D-06 successor authorization
tests.expected_outcome: Exclude incompatible financial admissions conditionally

tests.title: Provider webhooks are duplicated or out of order
tests.expected_outcome: No duplicate capacity release or state regression

tests.title: MongoDB or worker crashes after requesting Session expiration
tests.expected_outcome: Recover exact operation identity and reconcile after restart

tests.title: Browser arrives via cancel_url or closes a tab without authorization

tests.title: Cancellation is requested after capture is confirmed
tests.expected_outcome: Preserve the paid Order's commercial obligation
